description: This Java source file defines the TelemetryConsumerImpl class, which implements a client for consuming telemetry data from a Hono server using Vertx-Proton. It provides a static factory method to create telemetry consumers with specified parameters, managing the connection and message handling.

classes.name: TelemetryConsumerImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client implementation for consuming telemetry data from a Hono server.
